responsibility: Implementation of RTL SSA basic-block and extended-basic-block construction. This file builds bb_info and ebb_info objects from the CFG, partitions blocks into reverse-postorder EBBs, walks dominance to populate head/end artificial instructions and phi information, records call-clobber groupings, and provides printing and dumping helpers for block and EBB summaries.
same_name_distinction: Implements construction and population of bb_info and ebb_info from the CFG declared in blocks.h, including EBB formation, dominator walk block processing, phi placement/input population, and block/EBB dump logic; unlike blocks.h, it performs the build-time algorithms rather than defining the metadata types and iterators.
